build_VitDepthHead: build a VitDepthHead decode head with configurable deconv and conv layers for monocular depth estimation
create_make_conv_layers: create convolutional layers with InstanceNorm2d and SiLU activation for the depth head feature processing
create_make_deconv_layers: create deconvolutional upsample layers with configurable kernel sizes 2, 3, or 4 for depth map upsampling
run_forward_VitDepthHead: run the forward pass through deconv and conv layers to produce depth prediction logits from ViT features
review_loss_by_feat: review the loss computation method that resizes logits, applies sampling weights, and computes depth regression loss
